hero.tagline: Compare only the weather you need, at a glance
hero.subtitle: A simple weather app to intuitively check today's weather with recent feels-like temperature changes, and quickly compare weather across multiple regions.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Check today and tomorrow's weather smarter

weather.title: Feels-Like Temperature Graphs
weather.desc: Compare feels-like highs and lows for the recent 8 days and next 7 days to understand temperature trends at a glance.

comparison.title: Multi-Region Comparison
comparison.desc: Group multiple regions and compare their weather side by side on one screen.

widget.title: Home Screen Widget
widget.desc: Quickly check the weather with iOS and Android home screen widgets.

multilang.title: Multi-Language Support
multilang.desc: Supports 7 languages: 한국어, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 简体中文.

theme.title: Custom Themes
theme.desc: Adjust the app colors yourself and use Meteal with a look that fits you.

offline.title: Offline Cache
offline.desc: Recent weather data is cached on device so you can check it even when offline.

nogps.title: No GPS Required
nogps.desc: Works without precise location permission. Search and register regions manually.

datasources.label: Open Data
datasources.title: Data Sources
datasources.desc: Meteal uses reliable open-source data providers.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: How to use Meteal and detailed behavior descriptions

region_limits.title: Region & Group Registration Limits
region_limits.desc: Meteal provides basic features within the free tier. Rewarded ads are required to exceed the limits.
region_limits.note: Changing a region is NOT considered adding a new one — no ad is required. However, you cannot change to a region already registered in your single region list.

ad_info.title: Advertisement Information
ad_info.desc: Rewarded ads are required when adding regions/groups beyond the free range. Ads may fail to load due to:
ad_info.fallback_title: How ad load failures are handled
ad_info.fallback_online: If your internet connection is available but a rewarded ad cannot be loaded because of an ad server delay, unavailable ad inventory, or a temporary service issue, Meteal lets you continue without blocking the feature. A brief message is shown at the bottom of the app for about 3 seconds.
ad_info.fallback_offline: If there is no internet connection, ads cannot be loaded, so additional features may be temporarily limited and a network error message is shown.
ad_info.retry_policy: Meteal also limits repeated banner ad retries and retry intervals to avoid unnecessary ad requests. After the network recovers, it waits briefly before requesting ads again.

weather_codes.title: Weather Status Display Rules
weather_codes.desc: Weather conditions are displayed based on Open-Meteo weather codes as follows.

refresh.title: Weather Refresh Methods
refresh.row_group_method: Pull down to refresh group data
refresh.row_language_method: Refreshes data and updates widget labels

structure.title: Region & Group Management Structure
structure.row_group_desc: A list that groups multiple regions for comparison
structure.row_single_duplicate_desc: The same region cannot be registered twice
structure.row_group_duplicate_desc: The same region cannot be registered twice in the same group
structure.row_region_change_desc: Cannot change to a region already in the single region list

additional.title: Additional Information
additional.nogps: No GPS or location permission is used.
additional.data_source: Weather data: Open-Meteo / Region search: GeoNames
additional.status_badges: Weather data status badges: latest / cached / offline
additional.widget_single: Widgets refresh based on the selected single region.
additional.widget_no_group: Widgets do not display entire groups.
additional.supported_langs: Supported languages: 한국어, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 简体中文

data_storage.title: App Weather Data Storage & Refresh
data_storage.range: Data range: Hourly (past 7 + 7 forecast days), Daily (past 7 + 7 forecast days)
data_storage.included: Included: Temperature, Feels-like, Precipitation, Precipitation probability, Humidity, Cloud coverage, Weather codes, Wind speed/direction, Sunrise/Sunset

widget_refresh.title: Widget Data Refresh
widget_refresh.android_desc: Background work runs approximately every hour, fetches full Open-Meteo data range, and stores partial widget data.
widget_refresh.widget_data_items: Selected single region, Feels-like high/low for 8 days, Today AM/PM summary, Location, Collection time, Language labels
widget_refresh.ios_desc: Two paths: app background refresh + widget self-refresh
widget_refresh.ios_self_refresh: Widget self-refreshes if >1 hour has passed since last refresh and coordinates are available.

app_features.title: App Features
app_features.desc: Compare feels-like temperature trends and regional weather quickly in single-region and group views.
app_features.single_past: Feels-like high/low comparison graph for the recent 8 days, including today
app_features.single_future: Feels-like high/low comparison graph for the next 7 days, including today
app_features.group_weekly: Feels-like high/low comparison graph for each region over the next 7 days, including today

search.title: Search Behavior
search.desc: Region search checks both names in the currently selected app language and GeoNames default English/ASCII names.
search.ko_lang: Meteal first searches region names for the app language, then also searches the same query against GeoNames default English/ASCII names.
search.en_lang: This means English place names can be searched regardless of the selected app language.
search.reason: If a region does not appear in the selected language, try searching for its English name. Some regions may not have a name in every language, or the spelling may differ in GeoNames data.

display_rules.title: Common Display Rules
display_rules.desc: Meteal summarizes hourly data into daily, morning, and afternoon values that fit the app screens.
display_rules.day_weather_rule: Shows the weather condition that appears most often in the target time range.
display_rules.am_weather_rule: Shows the weather condition that appears most often during the morning period.
display_rules.pm_weather_rule: Shows the weather condition that appears most often during the afternoon period.
display_rules.am_temp_rule: Summarizes morning temperature data as an average or representative value.
display_rules.pm_temp_rule: Summarizes afternoon temperature data as an average or representative value.
display_rules.options_rule: Each option is summarized in a suitable way, such as total, average, or probability.

current_weather_basis.title: Why current temperature and hourly temperature may differ
current_weather_basis.desc1: Meteal prioritizes Open-Meteo current data for the current temperature so it can show a value closer to the present moment. Current data is provided based on 15-minute weather model data.
current_weather_basis.desc2: Temperatures shown in hourly tables and graphs use hourly data, based on 1-hour weather information. As a result, the current temperature and the hourly temperature for the same time period may not always match.
current_weather_basis.desc3: Meteal also does not display raw observations from a specific weather station. It uses forecast values provided by Open-Meteo, which combines multiple weather model datasets based on the coordinates of the selected region. Values may differ from national weather service apps or station observations depending on the region, elevation, model resolution, and interpolation method.

widgets.title: Widget Guide
widgets.basis: All widgets display information for the region most recently shown on the single-region screen.
widgets.android_home: Shows a recent 8-day feels-like high/low graph, morning and afternoon weather icons, current feels-like temperature, and current weather information.
widgets.ios_home: Home screen: shows a recent 8-day feels-like high/low graph, morning and afternoon weather icons, current feels-like temperature, and current weather information.
widgets.ios_lock_full: Lock screen: recent 8-day feels-like high/low comparison graph
widgets.ios_lock_split: Lock screen: separate feels-like high and low graphs
widgets.android_desc: Android home screen widgets use a transparent background, so they blend naturally with your home screen wallpaper.
widgets.ios_desc: iOS home screen widgets automatically adjust their background and colors for Light Mode and Dark Mode.

widget_temperature_basis.title: Widget Temperature Display Rules
widget_temperature_basis.desc1: The current temperature number shown in widgets is the current feels-like temperature. Meteal prioritizes Open-Meteo current apparent_temperature data so the widget stays consistent with its feels-like temperature focus.
widget_temperature_basis.desc2: The widget graph also shows the recent 8-day trend of feels-like highs and lows. However, the current feels-like temperature number uses current data for the present moment, while the graph uses daily high/low data, so the values may differ.
widget_temperature_basis.desc3: Morning and afternoon weather information is shown as a summary for representative times of the day and is calculated separately from the current feels-like temperature.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.s1_1_desc: We do not directly collect personal identifying information such as names, email addresses, or phone numbers.
s1.s1_2_desc: Advertising ID, Device info (model, OS version), Approximate location via IP, Ad interaction data.
s1.s1_3_desc: Registered regions, groups, and app settings are stored locally in a SQLite database on your device. The developer does NOT collect this data on any server.

s2.title: 2. Purpose of Data Usage
s2.items: Weather information / Location search / Ad display / App stability improvement

s3.title: 3. Third-Party Services
s3.desc: The following third-party services may process data.

s4.title: 4. Location Information
s4.desc: We do not request GPS or ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permissions. Only the coordinates of user-selected regions are sent to Open-Meteo for weather data retrieval.

s5.title: 5. Data Retention
s5.desc: User configuration data is stored on-device only and is deleted when the app is uninstalled. Third-party services follow their own privacy policies.

s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
s6.desc: This app is not directed toward children.

s7.title: 7. Security
s7.desc: As there are no developer-operated servers, all user data remains on your device.

s8.title: 8. Disclaimer
s8.desc: Weather data is provided by third-party services (Open-Meteo). Accuracy is not guaranteed.

s9.title: 9. Policy Changes
s9.desc: This policy may be updated and will be announced via the app or app stores.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.desc: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at the email below.
